At foot each tiny blade grew big And taller stood to hear, And every leaf on every twig Was like a little ear. As I too paused, and both ways tried To catch the rippling rain,-- So still, a hare kept at my side His tussock of disdain,-- Behind me close I heard a step, A soft pit-pat surprise, And looking round my eyes fell deep Into sweet other eyes; The eyes like wells, where sun lies

78563-the-judgment-of-johan-coull.title: The Judgment Of Johan Coull
78563-the-judgment-of-johan-coull.creator: Frederick Sleath
78563-the-judgment-of-johan-coull.description: A book by Frederick Sleath. Jackson missed his direction when he went down, and walked straight into them. First one, then two, with one athwart on top, and then the other; almost as if someone had chosen the place and popped them all down together. And not a plate started on one of them--leastways as far as we could see.

arxiv-2102-01944.title: All Infections are Not Created Equal: Time-Sensitive Prediction of Malware Generated Network Attacks
arxiv-2102-01944.creator: Zainab Abaid 1 2 , Dilip Sarkar 3 , Mohamed Ali Kaafar 2 4 and Sanjay Jha 1
arxiv-2102-01944.description: Abstract Many techniques have been proposed for quickly detecting and containing malware-generated network attacks such as large-scale denial of service attacks; unfortunately, much damage is already done within the first few minutes of an attack, before it is identified and contained.

arxiv-2212-06927.title: A spectroscopic multiplicity survey of Galactic Wolf-Rayet stars
arxiv-2212-06927.creator: K. Dsilva, T. Shenar, H. Sana, P. Marchant
arxiv-2212-06927.description: Abstract Context. Massive stars are powerful cosmic engines that have a huge impact on their surroundings and host galaxies. The majority of massive stars will interact with a companion star during their evolution. The effects of this interaction on their end-of-life products are currently poorly constrained.

arxiv-2306-09573.title: Reevaluation of Stark-induced transition polarizabilities in cesium
arxiv-2306-09573.creator: H. B. Tran Tan, D. Xiao, A. Derevianko
arxiv-2306-09573.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by H. B. Tran Tan, D. Xiao, A. Derevianko. Extracting electroweak observables from experiments on atomic parity violation (APV) using the Stark interference technique requires accurate knowledge of transition polarizabilities. In cesium, the focus of our paper, the 6 ​ S 1 / 2 → 7 ​ S 1 / 2 6S_{1/2}\rightarrow{7S_{1/2}} APV amplitude is deduced from the measured ratio of the APV amplitude to the vector transition polarizability, β \beta .

arxiv-2310-05604.title: Photon-number resolution with microwave Josephson photomultipliers
arxiv-2310-05604.creator: E. V. Stolyarov, O. V. Kliushnichenko, V. S. Kovtoniuk, A. A. Semenov
arxiv-2310-05604.description: Abstract We study counting photons confined in a mode of a microwave resonator via repeated measurements by a Josephson photomultiplier (JPM). The considered JPM is essentially a flux-biased phase qubit operating as a single-photon detector. We identify optimal operational regimes that maximize photon-number resolution within a predetermined range. Two counting techniques are studied.

arxiv-2311-17585.title: A computational tool for symbolic derivation of the small angle scattering from complex composite structures
arxiv-2311-17585.creator: Tobias W. J
arxiv-2311-17585.description: Abstract Analysis of small angle scattering (SAS) data requires intensive modelling to infer and characterize the structures present in a sample. This iterative improvement of models is a time consuming process. Here we present the Scattering Equation Builder (SEB), a C++ library that derives exact analytic expressions for the form factor of complex composite structures.

arxiv-2405-11590.title: Global Convergence of Decentralized Retraction-Free Optimization on the Stiefel Manifold
arxiv-2405-11590.creator: Youbang Sun, Shixiang Chen, Alfredo Garcia, Shahin Shahrampour
arxiv-2405-11590.description: Abstract Many classical and modern machine learning algorithms require solving optimization tasks under orthogonal constraints. Solving these tasks often require calculating retraction-based gradient descent updates on the corresponding Riemannian manifold, which can be computationally expensive. Recently [ 1 ] proposed an infeasible retraction-free algorithm, which is significantly more efficient.

arxiv-2507-23116.title: Alpha-Z divergence unveils further distinct phenotypic traits of human brain connectivity fingerprint
arxiv-2507-23116.creator: Md Kaosar Uddin, Nghi Nguyen, Huajun Huang, Duy Duong-Tran, Jingyi Zheng
arxiv-2507-23116.description: Abstract SUMMARY The accurate identification of individuals from functional connectomes (FCs) is critical for advancing individualized assessments in neuro/psychiatric research. Traditional methods, such as using Pearson’s correlation, have limitations in capturing the complex, non-Euclidean geometry of FC data, leading to suboptimal performance in identifying individual differences.

The area of the district is 4158 sq. It consists chiefly of elevated land intersected by river valleys. A range of hills rising to nearly 4000 feet crosses it from north to south, forming the water parting between the systems of the Krishna and the Cauvery. The principal streams are the Jayamangala and the Shimsha.

europmc-pmc2898859.creator: Liu Y, Wu F.
europmc-pmc2898859.description: Background Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), or liver cancer, is the third leading cause of cancer deaths worldwide, with prevalence 16-32 times higher in developing countries than in developed countries. Aflatoxin, a contaminant produced by the fungi Aspergillus flavus and Asperg

pmc-11353034.title: Screening Accuracy for Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip by Child Health Nurses
pmc-11353034.creator: Larissa Smart, William Cundy, Nicole Williams, Abigail Arnold, Jessie Childs, Lemuel Pelentsov, Adrian Esterman
pmc-11353034.description: Background: Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip (DDH) describes a spectrum of abnormalities that impact the normal function of the joint. These abnormalities are detectable during infancy using physical assessment, universal ultrasound, or a combination of both. In Australia, child health nurses predominantly screen for this disease using physical assessment.

pmc-11429962.title: Evolving indications and surgical techniques for corneal transplantation at a tertiary eye care center in southern China
pmc-11429962.creator: Shu-rong Li, Yao-lei Du, Zhe-wen Zheng, Jin-yu Zhang, Shi-you Zhou
pmc-11429962.description: BackgroundThis retrospective study aimed to analyze the evolution of primary indications and surgical techniques for corneal transplantation in Southern China from 2012 to 2021.MethodsThe medical charts of all patients who underwent keratoplasty between January 2012 and December 2021 at Zhongshan Ophthalmic Centre, Sun Yat-Sen University, Guangzhou, Southern China were reviewed.

pmc-12473016.title: Protective Role of Multiple Essential Minerals Against Cadmium-Related Cognitive Decline in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Prospective Study
pmc-12473016.creator: Jing Yang, Zongyao Li, Yongbin Zhao, Yanzhen Hu, Xinyang Guo, Xi Kang, Zhenyu Wu, Chang Su, Tao Zhang
pmc-12473016.description: Background: Cadmium (Cd) exposure is linked to cognitive decline in middle-aged and older adults, but the modifying role of essential minerals is unclear. This study aimed to identify key protective minerals and quantify their joint antagonistic effect against Cd neurotoxicity.

pmc-13076326.title: Predictive value of dipstick urinalysis for detecting pyelonephritis in children aged 0–12 months
pmc-13076326.creator: Philippe Juvet, Jean-Yves Pauchard, Francois Cachat, Hassib Chehade
pmc-13076326.description: Background and objectivesUrinary tract infections (UTIs) are the most common serious bacterial infections during the first year of life. Symptoms of UTI in young children are non-specific, making diagnosis challenging.MethodWe conducted a retrospective single-center study over a period of 5 years.

pmc-13081311.title: Comparative biomechanical analysis of hinge fracture risk between medial open-wedge high tibial osteotomy and distal tuberosity osteotomy: a porcine tibia study
pmc-13081311.creator: Hibiki Kakiage, Yoshiya Nibe, Tsuneari Takahashi, Katsushi Takeshita, Hirotaka Chikuda
pmc-13081311.description: BackgroundMedial open-wedge high tibial osteotomy (OWHTO) is widely performed to correct varus malalignment associated with medial compartment osteoarthritis of the knee. Despite its popularity, this technique is frequently accompanied by undesirable complications, such as lateral hinge fractures, an increase in posterior tibial slope (PTS), and a reduction in patellar height.

pmc-13119454.title: Effects of Time-Restricted Eating on Circadian Cortisol Secretion and Obesity-Related Metabolic Markers in Cushing’s Disease: A Pilot Study
pmc-13119454.creator: Lala Soltanova, Ceren Iseri, Serdar Sahin, Mihriban Kara, Suzan Aydin Guclu, Busra Yesilova, Ilkin Muradov, Banu Betul Kocaman, Pinar Kadioglu
pmc-13119454.description: Purpose: The aims of this study were to evaluate the feasibility of time-restricted eating (TRE) in patients with Cushing’s disease (CD) and assess its effects on body weight and metabolic parameters. Methods: Twelve CD patients in remission with obesity were enrolled in a TRE program restricting food intake to 10:00–18:00.

pmc-13226651.title: Multi-sensor microclimate and tree canopy dataset from a linden tree for green infrastructure validation
pmc-13226651.creator: Peer Schöneberger, Tim Sinsel, Helge Simon, Michael Bruse
pmc-13226651.description: Validating microclimate simulation models requires accurate in-situ measurements across multiple spatial locations and environmental parameters. This dataset provides a detailed collection of microclimate observations gathered around a linden tree (Tilia cordata) located in Grünstadt, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany, over a three-day period in June 2025.

pmc-13312008.title: Ixazomib with chemotherapy for childhood relapsed acute lymphoblastic leukemia: a TACL consortium report∗
pmc-13312008.creator: Eric S. Schafer, Holly L. Pacenta, Yueh-Yun Chi, Jemily Malvar, Andrew Doan, Reuven J. Schore, Teresa Rushing, Roy Leong, Sean Bujarski, Paul S. Gaynon, Seth E. Karol, Julio C. Barredo, Susan R. Rheingold, Van Huynh, Nathan P. Gossai, Bill H. Chang, Tamra Slone, Melinda Pauly, Alan S. Wayne, Deepa B
pmc-13312008.description: Key Points•The oral formulation of ixazomib is accepted and well tolerated by children with R/R ALL.•Ixazomib, in addition to standard relapsed chemotherapy, is tolerable and has a promising early efficacy signal in R/R ALL. Introduction There has been steady incremental improvement in outcomes for children and young adults with acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) since the middle of the 20th century.

pmc-13567033.title: Preparation and Characterization of Fenofibric Acid-Loaded Electrospun Fibrous Mats
pmc-13567033.creator: Enikő Bitay, Gergő Tóth, Zoltán-István Szabó
pmc-13567033.description: Fenofibric acid-loaded microfibrous mats were produced by electrospinning using polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) as a carrier polymer. Fenofibric acid, obtained through alkaline hydrolysis of fenofibrate, was incorporated into PVP solutions and processed under optimized electrospinning conditions to obtain uniform, defect-free fibers. The morphology and average fiber diameter were examined by scanning electron microscopy, revealing homogeneous, continuous fibers.
